title: 2,000-year-old tomb of an elite nomad in Mongolia contained a Roman glass cup and Han-dynasty-inspired jade decorations
caption:
A 2,000-year-old Xiongnu tomb in Mongolia has unveiled an incredible mix of global artifacts. From Roman glass to Han-dynasty jade, this burial site reveals the vast reach of ancient nomadic trade networks.
